result.markdown: --- gd-head-tags: - >- ``{=html} open-graph: title: >- [Graph.add_scale_free_graph()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} | Edgecase description: >- Add a scale-free directed multigraph (the Bollobás-Borgs-Chayes-Riordan model). twitter-card: title: >- [Graph.add_scale_free_graph()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} | Edgecase description: >- Add a scale-free directed multigraph (the Bollobás-Borgs-Chayes-Riordan model). title: >- [Graph.add_scale_free_graph()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 bread-crumbs: false toc-depth: 3 description-meta: >- Add a scale-free directed multigraph (the Bollobás-Borgs-Chayes-Riordan model). page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Add a scale-free directed multigraph (the Bollobás-Borgs-Chayes-Riordan model). ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L12002-L12127){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-function} ```pythonsignature Graph.add_scale_free_graph( n, alpha=0.41, beta=0.54, gamma=0.05, delta_in=0.2, delta_out=0.0, seed=None, type=None, label=True, rel=None, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Scale-free directed graph](../assets/graphs/add-scale-free-graph.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="Three scale-free directed graphs on 4, 6, and 8 nodes on a ring, grown from a three- cycle by the default mix of steps that add a node with an arc out, add an arc between existing nodes, or add a node with an arc in. One node quickly becomes the hub, touching 7 of the 10 arcs at n=8; it and one neighbor have arcs both ways, plus a repeated arc at n=8, drawn bowed apart, because the model keeps parallel arcs." width="100%"} Starts from a directed 3-cycle and adds one edge per step until there are `n` nodes: - with probability `alpha`, from a new node to an existing node chosen by in-degree - with probability `beta`, between two existing nodes, the source chosen by out-degree and the target by in-degree - with probability `gamma`, from an existing node chosen by out-degree to a new node A node is chosen by in-degree with probability proportional to its in-degree plus `delta_in` (and likewise by out-degree with `delta_out`), so the deltas give nodes without any edges of that kind a chance. Both the in-degrees and the out-degrees follow power laws, with exponents set by the parameters. Because `beta` steps join existing nodes freely, self-loops and parallel edges can appear, and they are kept. The number of edges is random, about `n / (alpha + gamma)`. The defaults are NetworkX's, and the process follows NetworkX's `scale_free_graph()`. In an undirected graph the same edges are added without their direction. The graph is appended without touching or connecting to existing nodes, and the whole construction is recorded as a single step. Scale-free graphs are useful for: - modeling the web graph and other directed networks with heavy-tailed in- and out-degrees - tuning in- and out-degree exponents separately - stress-testing directed algorithms on graphs with hubs, loops, and repeated edges ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [n]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Number of nodes. Must be at least `3`. [alpha]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[0.41]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Probability of adding a new node with an edge to an existing node. Default is `0.41`. [beta]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[0.54]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Probability of adding an edge between existing nodes. Default is `0.54`. [gamma]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[0.05]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Probability of adding a new node with an edge from an existing node. Default is `0.05`. `alpha`, `beta`, and `gamma` must be positive and sum to `1`. [delta_in]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[0.2]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Bias added to every in-degree when choosing a target. Default is `0.2`. Must be non-negative. [delta_out]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[0.0]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Bias added to every out-degree when choosing a source. Default is `0.0`. Must be non-negative. [seed]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Integer seed for the random number generator. The same `seed=` with the same other arguments always gives the same graph. If `None` (default), the graph differs on every call. [type]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional value stored in the `type` attribute of every new node. If `None` (default), no `type` attribute is set. [label]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[True]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True` (default), each new node is labelled with its node ID as a string; a label that is already used raises `ValueError` before anything is added. If `False`, the nodes are left unlabelled. [rel]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional value stored in the `rel` attribute of every new edge. If `None` (default), no `rel` attribute is set. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. The graph is modified in place. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If `n=` is less than `3`, any of `alpha=`, `beta=`, and `gamma=` is not positive, they don't sum to `1`, or `delta_in=` or `delta_out=` is negative. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} With the default parameters, most steps add an edge between existing nodes, so there are about twice as many edges as nodes: ::: {#1bbe19dd .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph(directed=True).add_scale_free_graph(n=200, seed=11) graph.count_nodes(), graph.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` (200, 427) ``` ::: ::: A few nodes collect most of the in-edges: ::: {#d1730624 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} sorted((graph.get_in_degree(v) for v in graph.get_node_ids()), reverse=True)[:5] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` [111, 93, 80, 25, 9] ``` ::: ::: Self-loops and parallel edges are part of the model: ::: {#e591bc70 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph.count_all_loops(), graph.count_multi_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` (7, 85) ``` ::: :::
